scope: Selected AC1018 text-cell alignment override mask 0x01 and combination 0x21 with text height; accept alignment 1–9, require a finite positive height when 0x20 is set, and refuse inconsistent companions or other masks. This scope is an inference from documented bit layouts and original fields, not an exact independently produced legacy profile.

source.note: Original flag mask is 0x666f and carries additional background, color and border overrides. Its groups 175 and 176 are 3 and 2; this is not a complete source-cell round trip or a producer witness of exact 0x01 or 0x21. Existing external repository sample used read-only; native producer not independently established.

authorities.interpretation: Autodesk names 170 as cell alignment, 140 as text height, 177 as the pre-2007 override flag, and lists the nine table alignment enum values. It does not individually certify the exact AC1018 mask profiles or native rendering.

libredwg.interpretation: The pre-2007 DXF field uses group 177; conditional independent bit tests associate 0x01 with alignment group 170 and 0x20 with text-height group 140.

acadsharp.interpretation: DWG flag enum independently names 0x01 CellAlignment and 0x20 TextHeight; its DXF reader ignores group 170 and cannot establish typed legacy semantics.
